description.p: yanklog keeps copied text searchable without sending clipboard content off your device. Clipboard history is stored in a local encrypted database and can be paused or filtered whenever needed.

Search the complete history, pin useful clips, undo accidental deletions, and open the keyboard-focused Quick Pick window from a desktop shortcut. Retention limits and privacy filters control what is captured and how long it is kept.
Password-encrypted backups can move selected items or the complete history between yanklog installations.

screenshot.caption: Search and manage encrypted clipboard history

description.p: The app is called yanklog everywhere: in the app launcher, windows, menus and dialogs.

ul.li: The selected Settings tab is highlighted, and the tabs sit in the header bar.
The About tab lists the license and links to the website, source code and issue tracker.

description.p: yanklog no longer needs X11 or a tray icon.

ul.li: Clipboard history works on GNOME Wayland without X11.
The database key is kept through the Secret portal, whatever password manager you use.
The main window has a menu with Quit (Ctrl+Q), so yanklog can be closed without a tray icon.

description.p: History saved by earlier Flatpak builds cannot be opened by this version and is moved aside.
The Flatpak build now reports its correct version, and the Flatpak release history is up to date.
Starting at login works again on systems where the keyring is not ready right after login, and a locked keyring no longer leads to a new key that cannot open existing history.
A redesigned main window and Quick Pick, standard GNOME settings, faster Quick Pick from the running app, and more dependable pausing.

ul.li: History is grouped into Pinned, Today, Yesterday, and Earlier.
Quick Pick shows the full text of the highlighted clip.
Privacy and history settings apply at once, without a restart.
Nothing copied while paused is saved, and a pause stays on after a restart.

description.p: Flatpak tray integration and portal-based start-at-login support.
Native Wayland clipboard support, refreshed Flatpak packaging, and Flathub submission metadata.
Faster complete-history search, encrypted backups, safer deletion, timed pauses, improved Quick Pick, onboarding, and refreshed settings.
